sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:1

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:1:1
items.html:
BYA themselves — what was their discernment: That is to say, from where the self of the three worlds BYA came into being, and what was their discernment at first, before they were corrected into Sefirot and into Partzufim. And this is what he goes on to explain in this discourse.
And this is a very important piece of knowledge — to know wherein the three worlds BYA became so greatly changed from the world of Atzilut, until they are regarded as the worlds of separation, whose vessels and whose Ruach and Nefesh of the externality are not Godly, as is known. And this discourse deserves particular attention, for without it there is no true understanding whatsoever in all that is said in the discourses on BYA.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:1:2
items.html:
From half of the Tifferet and the NHY of Adam Kadmon until the end of his feet: That is, from the Tabur and below of AK, which is regarded as a separate Partzuf in its own right, and which divides into three parts: HBD, HGT, NHYM, as the ARI wrote in Etz Chaim, Gate 8, Chapter 3 — study it there well. It is also known that the Tifferet is divided at the Chazeh [chest], so that from the Chazeh upward it is included in HGT, and from the Chazeh downward it is included in NHY, as is known. And here, in this Partzuf, was the second restriction that the ARI explains further on; and likewise it became the internality for all the ten Sefirot of the world of Nekudim; and likewise all the four worlds of ABYA clothe upon it.
And one must remember that before the second restriction the Partzuf SAG of AK too ended level with the feet of the Partzuf of Keter of AK (as the ARI wrote in Etz Chaim, Gate 9, Chapter 6), that is, at the point of this world, in the secret of the verse “and His feet shall stand upon the Mount of Olives” (as the ARI wrote in Etz Chaim, Gate 3, Chapter 2 — See there). And that part of SAG which was clothing upon the Tabur and below of the Partzuf of Keter of AK was likewise set apart as a Partzuf of its own, called the Partzuf of the Nekudot of SAG, as the ARI wrote in Etz Chaim, Gate 9, Chapter 6. And with this you will understand that in this half of the Tifferet and the NHY of AK with which the ARI deals here, what is spoken of is in inclusion together with the Tabur and below of the Partzuf SAG. And remember this.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:1:3
items.html:
Their externality divides into two discernments, and behold, their externality from the side of the face is called Beria, and that from the side of the back is called Yetzira and Assiya: The explanation is that the Partzuf TNHY of AK divides into internality and externality, as written just above, that there is nothing for you that does not have internality and externality in it. And this division is at the Chazeh [chest] of every Partzuf, for from the Chazeh upward, which are HBD HGT down to the Chazeh, is called by the name internality; and from the Chazeh downward, which are TNHYM, is called by the name externality. And so it is also in the Partzuf TNHY of AK, whose Chazeh and below is called by the name externality. And he says that this externality of the Partzuf TNHY, which is the Chazeh and below of this Partzuf TNHY, divides into two discernments called face and back: that the externality from the side of the face is called Beria, and that from the side of the back is called Yetzira and Assiya.
And the matter of the division of the Chazeh and below into face and back is chiefly at the middle third of Tifferet, which is regarded as the side of the face, since it is the discernment of YESHSUT of the Guf [body]; and from the bottom third of Tifferet until the Sium of the feet is called the side of the back of the Chazeh and below, they being the discernment of ZON of the Guf, as written below. Indeed they are not yet BYA, but rather the ARI calls them by the name of the future.
